clue.text: Player securing fine wicket — a declaration may follow it

indicators.note: the player holds the other pieces fast within himself, so they go inside

parts.note: an actor is a player on the stage
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
W is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for wicket
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cricketer takes a wicket, and the captain may then declare the innings closed.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket surface makes 'declaration' sound like closing an innings; here it is a declaration of war.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostile act by one state against another can be followed by a formal announcement that hostilities have begun.

clue.text: Horrified to have a good speed limited

indicators.note: kept short, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: haste is speed

clue.text: Your move at first to join our side? You'll get it in the neck!

explanation.definitionFit: The thymus is a gland at the base of the neck, behind the breastbone.

clue.text: In the last round, new government agency concerned with funding

clue.text: Standard apparently not observed?

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a permissive situation where every behaviour is allowed.

clue.text: Old medicine finally changed for modern therapy

explanation.definitionFit: Physio is the everyday short form of physiotherapy, a treatment using exercise and massage.

clue.text: In a hurry, Harry, not having arrived in front of George

explanation.definitionFit: Hying means hastening or going quickly, from the archaic verb hie.

the police tow away an illegally parked car

clue.text: Broken toes, small but extremely thick

explanation.definitionFit: Obtuse means dim or slow-witted, so the superlative is the dimmest.

explanation.walkthrough: Hay-on-Wye is a small town on the Welsh border famous for its secondhand bookshops and annual literary festival.
explanation.definitionFit: The well-known Hay literary festival is held each year in this Welsh border town.

clue.text: After landslide perhaps rescue detective with problem afoot

clue.text: Chuck beer heartily over top bouncer

clue.text: Sort of figure one must reform rough girl

explanation.walkthrough: The Christmas Eve service is held at midnight and draws large congregations.
explanation.definitionFit: Midnight Mass is a eucharist celebrated as Christmas Day begins.

clue.text: Fury: is it on reflection something many check regularly?

explanation.walkthrough: The Furies of Greek myth were three avenging goddesses: Alecto, Megaera and Tisiphone.
explanation.definitionFit: Tisiphone is one of the three Erinyes, the avenging goddesses of Greek myth.

clue.text: A fool for quietly producing fake news?

clue.text: Self-indulgent type has done this wrong

indicators.note: the letters are put in the wrong order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A pleasure-seeker has behaved badly here.
explanation.definitionFit: A hedonist lives for pleasure and gratification.

clue.text: Birds, egg-layers for reproduction, full of goodness

definitions.text: that may be stuck in the hair
